title: Audit all three P104 accumulation traces and complete invoices
body:
PR5802 adds three destination sums to the strongest pending P104 word. A final matrix check alone does not show that each source read and retained COPY sees the same value. This independent implementation checks all three pending-sum traces against exact PR5786, with no source constructor or checker imports.

The audit matches 22,516 scalar events, 22,462 source observations and all 23 COPY values. It checks every formal input column in the 795/798-column words and reconstructs the complete p16/a7 signed invoice, including changed helper targets, owned lifetimes, scalar and route charges. The proof states the native frame-conversion premise and proves strict recursive gain for every exponent in `(0,1)`. It does not certify a new kappa or admit the supplier.

Validation: registered Python 3.12 replay, 200 independent dense oracle pairs, 13 semantic rejection controls, exact committed bytes and modes, and a sealed Git-free `-I -O -B` replay with a source-corruption control. Full Git ancestry was not checked in the shallow checkout. Native implementation, physical caller action, compiler, precision tape and outer analytic recovery remain outside this audit; all five framework assumptions remain.

Coordination: [scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19205496). Exact sources: PR5802 `9bab1ca917ec4d1a4e60f4eb8c81d7ef92908a62` and PR5786 `6b936acd68a7e0f9062037900f0fe9bc4b6fdd25`. Credit the construction authors and retained predecessor notices. New audit by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Hosted CI and independent human review are pending. The selected frontier is unchanged.


Clean-checkout source repair: the initial hosted job could not resolve pending predecessor commits. SOURCES.json now binds the exact retained input copies in this PR history; retained_predecessors preserves every original head, path, blob and SHA256 plus the retained file/archive member. Original and retained bytes were checked equal. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and declared-pin ancestry checks pass. Source bytes, mathematical assertions and scientific receipts are unchanged. The full-history preflight remains unrun in this shallow checkout. Hosted replay is queued for the new head. The unchanged test-only [PR5761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761) dependency also repairs the shared priority-revision planning tests and retains its original author and commit attribution.
